technique_name: Describe the elements of the Democratic Party's platform.
description: The Democratic Party platform generally includes support for progressive taxation and government spending to help revitalize the economy and create new jobs; protecting civil rights, workers' rights, and voting rights; increasing the minimum wage; advocating for stronger environmental regulations; reforming health care and encouraging renewable energy sources; promoting LGBT rights; expanding voting rights; reducing gun violence; and supporting immigration reform.
